reply:
rms have near-zero coefficients, so they are probably artifacts of the fit.

The main unresolved structure is at small strain (eps below about 1), where the residuals are largest. Terms built from sqrt(eps) and log(eps) helped most in my searches, but none of the forms I tried reached the exact law.

best.code:
import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(eps)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T + p[3]/eps + p[4]*T/eps
            + p[5]*np.sqrt(eps)*T**3 + p[6]*L*T**4/eps + p[7]*eps*T**3 + p[8]*L*T**2 + p[9]*T**2)
